(1) **PASS** – The three KPI tiles share uniform internal padding, consistent label/value font sizing, and equal vertical alignment.
(2) **PASS** – All text is fully legible with no truncation, clipping, or overlapping elements within the readouts.
(3) **PASS** – The UI correctly utilizes the zinc (dark backgrounds/text) and emerald (accents/positive metrics) color palette.
(4) **PASS** – No visual defects such as broken borders, misaligned icons, or rendering artifacts are present.
